notes.title: Updates v.1000-1.005
notes.content:
1. Added option to turn auto pause on and off
2. When you return to the game screen, the speed that was previously set will be selected
3. Now the reward timer does not count down while the game is paused
4. Added maximum values for some rewards upgrades
5. Reduced the interest percent for better balance
